result.description: The Aster Loom 27QW is a fictional 27-inch desktop monitor designed for calm productivity and color-managed illustration work rather than gaming or workstation compute. It uses a 2560 x 1440 IPS panel with a 100 Hz refresh rate, a 350-nit brightness target, and factory calibration for soft-surface editing tasks. The display includes USB-C input with 65 W power delivery, HDMI 2.0, DisplayPort 1.4, and a fully adjustable stand with pivot and height controls. Its narrow bezel and matte anti-glare finish make it suitable for compact studio desks and multi-monitor office layouts.
